tasks.short: Use cameras, tripods, filters, and flash

steps.what: Use traditional or digital cameras, along with tripods
Use a variety of equipment, filters, and flash attachments

tasks.design: The photographer uses traditional or digital cameras, along with equipment such as tripods, filters, and flash attachments. The handling stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} operates the camera.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer handles the camera and the attachments.
tasks.enabler_now: No rig replaces the photographer's hands.
tasks.still_hard: Operating the camera stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer stops when the attachment is the wrong one.
tasks.altitude: Handling the camera stays at full effort.

reach.task: Pass the attachment the photographer names
reach.learn: Which attachments were the wrong ones.

evidence.claim: Using cameras, tripods, filters, and flash attachments stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a camera and ends when the photographer has used it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A later maintenance check is a different task.
unknowns: Which attachments belong on which camera.
research_questions: How often was the attachment the wrong one?

already_counted.description: Using the cameras is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the shoot adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every camera is still used by the photographer. High: the same handling remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Manipulate and enhance scanned or digital images
Create desired effects using computers and specialized software

tasks.design: The photographer manipulates and enhances scanned or digital images to create desired effects, using computers and specialized software. The retouch stays at full effort. {DOCS} does not generate the effect. An altered picture is not published here.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer retouches the image by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: No generated effect replaces the retouch.
tasks.still_hard: The effect stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer rejects an effect the assignment does not support.
tasks.altitude: Creative retouching stays at full effort. Nothing is published from this task.

reach.task: Say which effect they asked for

evidence.claim: Creative retouching of a scanned or digital image stays manual.

An image altered so that it would falsely appear authentic has to be disclosed, and an intimate image of an identifiable person is out of scope. The retouch stays the photographer's, and nothing is published here.

assumptions: The work starts with an image and ends when the photographer has made the effect, or stops. Nothing is published.
No new record is required beyond the file the photographer saves. Upkeep is zero.
Publishing the image is a different task.
research_questions: Which effects did the photographer reject?

already_counted.description: Manipulating the image is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the retouch adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every effect is still made by the photographer. High: the same retouch remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Take pictures of individuals or families, either in studio
Take pictures of small groups on location

tasks.design: The photographer takes pictures of individuals, families, and small groups, either in studio or on location. The shoot stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} takes the picture. Nobody is scored. Nothing is published here.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer takes the pictures in the studio or on location.
tasks.enabler_now: No remote step takes the picture.
tasks.still_hard: Taking the picture stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer does not shoot a person who has not agreed to be there.
tasks.altitude: The shoot stays at full effort. Nothing is published.

reach.task: Say who is to be in the picture

evidence.claim: Taking pictures of people in studio or on location stays manual. Nothing is published in this step.

assumptions: The work starts with the people and ends when the photographer has taken the pictures, or stops.
No score is stored. Upkeep is zero. Nothing is published.
A later caption or licence is a different task.
unknowns: Which sittings are in studio, and which are on location.
research_questions: How often did the photographer stop a sitting?

already_counted.description: Taking the studio pictures is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the shoot adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every picture is still taken by the photographer. High: the same shoot remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Retouch and resize photographs and negatives

steps.what: Enhance and retouch photographs and negatives using airbrushing
Resize photographs and negatives using other techniques

tasks.design: The photographer enhances, retouches, and resizes photographs and negatives, using airbrushing and other techniques. The retouch stays at full effort, including the resize, because the crop is part of the picture. Nothing in {DOCS} retouches or publishes the image.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer retouches and resizes by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: No generated retouch replaces the hand work.
tasks.still_hard: The retouch and the crop stay with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer rejects a crop that changes the picture they meant.
tasks.altitude: Creative retouching stays at full effort. The resize is part of that judgement, so it is not cut.

reach.task: Say what must remain in the frame

evidence.claim: Enhancing, retouching, and resizing photographs, including by airbrushing, stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a photograph or a negative and ends when the photographer has retouched it, or stops.
No new record is required beyond the file the photographer saves. Upkeep is zero. Nothing is published.
The resize is not separated from the retouch, so its time is not removed.
unknowns: Which techniques are airbrushing, and which are other techniques.
research_questions: Which crops did the photographer reject?

already_counted.description: Retouching the photographs is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the retouch adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every retouch is still done by the photographer. High: the same retouch remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The photographer still shoots, retouches, and chooses the picture. A caption or a licence is written or sent only after the photographer accepts that version.
reach: A client receives only a caption the photographer has accepted.
An agency receives only a licence the photographer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required reading, field, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the shot, the retouch, and the selection in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every caption traces to stored who, what, where, and when, and the photographer still rewrites the sentence.
